# Olga Sirenko

> Product Designer, Product Design Leader & AI Systems Architect based in the Seattle–Portland area of the Pacific Northwest (PNW), United States. 12+ years of enterprise SaaS experience, a computer programming degree, and an international footprint across the US, Austria, and Ukraine.

Olga Sirenko leads product design for complex enterprise SaaS platforms, agentic AI workflows, and DesignOps automation, and advises Seed and Series-A AI founders on latency, non-deterministic state design, and user retention.

## Core Pages

- [About & Portfolio](https://olgasirenko.com/): Overview of Olga Sirenko's product design leadership, operating principles, career timeline (Vividly, Quantum Metric, Equinix, Vienna Press Bureau), and academic foundations.
- [AI UX Advisory & 48-Hour Architecture Audit](https://olgasirenko.com/#/advisory): Two engagement tracks—48-Hour Architecture Audit ($1,500 flat investment) and Strategic Advisory & Retainers (capped at two companies).
- [Writing & Essays](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing): Six technical essays on enterprise AI systems, agentic UX, accessibility/machine-readable UI, and design leadership.
- [Complete Factual Dossier](https://olgasirenko.com/llms-full.txt): Full structured profile, career history, services, FAQs, and essay summaries for AI search agents.

## Key Facts & Expertise

- **Location**: Seattle – Portland area, Pacific Northwest (PNW), United States (available locally and globally)
- **Roles & Focus**: Product Designer, Product Design Leader, AI Systems Architect, Principal/Director-level Product Design, Fractional AI UX Advisor
- **Experience**: 12+ years in enterprise SaaS, developer & data platforms, and AI workflow automation; 3+ years in advisory practice
- **Current Leadership**: Vividly (2025–Present) — Leading product design for the AI-agent-powered Vividly Hub enterprise SaaS platform and DesignOps AI automation
- **Prior Leadership**: Quantum Metric (2020–2025), Equinix (2019–2020), Vienna Press Bureau & Creative Direction (2012–2016)
- **Education**: A.S. in Computer Programming (data structures, algorithms, OOP, robotics & IoT); M.A. & B.A. in Communication Systems (journalism & communication frameworks)

## Essays

- [The Death of Hierarchical Navigation](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing/death-of-hierarchical-navigation): Why AI intent shifts sitemaps from the front door to the fallback.
- [The death of the passive dashboard](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing/death-of-passive-dashboard): Separating machine pattern detection from human trade-off decisions.
- [Dual-audience UI](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing/dual-audience-ui): Designing interfaces that work equally well for AI agents and screen readers.
- [The death of the Double Diamond](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing/death-of-double-diamond): Why working code is the fastest learning loop when prototyping is cheap.
- [Why chatbots fail enterprise software](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing/chatbots-fail-enterprise): Embedding intelligence inside existing work surfaces instead of chat drawers.
- [Designing for non-deterministic states](https://olgasirenko.com/#/writing/non-deterministic-state-design): Keeping AI products dependable when the underlying model output varies.
